name: dumbbell single leg hip thrust v. 2
description: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It hits the glutes hard and shows up strength imbalances.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
